title: Relationship
description: The standing connection between two Person records, including the relationship class (C0–C5), social capital, and protection status. A Relationship is separate from a ContactRoute (how to reach them) and from an AppearanceOpportunity (a specific invite attempt). Relationships accrue over time; opportunities come and go.

relationship_id.description: Stable UUID for this relationship edge.

person_a_id.description: person_id of the first party (typically the host or team member).

person_b_id.description: person_id of the second party (typically the guest candidate).

relationship_class.description: Classification of closeness. C0=no connection, C1=public adjacency, C2=prior professional interaction, C3=recurring colleague, C4=friend, C5=close friend/mentor/sensitive. C4–C5 require explicit owner approval for any contact.

relationship_owner_id.description: person_id of the person (host, producer) who owns and can authorize use of this relationship.

protected.description: If true, any outreach through this relationship requires explicit approval from relationship_owner_id. Always true for C4–C5.

permission_to_mention_mutual.description: Whether the outreach may reference a mutual connection by name.

previous_favors_provided.description: Favors, introductions, or social capital extended by person_a to person_b (tracked to avoid over-asking).

previous_favors_requested.description: Asks previously made of person_b through this relationship.

direct_ask_comfort.description: Estimated comfort level for a direct personal ask, 1 (not comfortable) to 5 (very comfortable). Based on relationship history, not assumption.

social_cost.description: Estimated social cost of making an ask through this relationship. 1=negligible, 5=exhausts goodwill.

reputational_sensitivity.description: Flag for relationships where a mishandled contact could cause reputational harm.

notes.description: Human-supplied context about this relationship. Never auto-generated.
